verdict.rationale: The pack documents declarative infrastructure-as-code (Bicep, ARM templates, Terraform with HCL export). None of it shows Azure itself versioning, reviewing, or rolling back automations: there is no deployment history, change preview or approval, or rollback evidence. Keeping templates in an external source-control system would be a user-side workaround, not the product's own capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
